definitions.rationale: Defines the named checkDictLoopBody AST term by exact expansion to the translated loop statements; it is a structural proof helper and does not replace an execution step.
definitions.text:
rule checkDictLoopBody()
    => Assign(Name("seen_key"), Bool(true))
       Assign(
         Name("is_string"),
         BoolOp(
           "and",
           BoolOp("or", Name("all_lower"), Name("all_upper")),
           Call(Name("isinstance"), Name("key"), Name("str"))))
       Assign(
         Name("all_lower"),
         BoolOp(
           "and",
           Name("all_lower"),
           Name("is_string"),
           Call(Attribute(Name("key"), "islower"), .Exprs)))
       Assign(
         Name("all_upper"),
         BoolOp(
           "and",
           Name("all_upper"),
           Name("is_string"),
           Call(Attribute(Name("key"), "isupper"), .Exprs)))

definitions.rationale: Defines the named checkDictReturn AST term by exact expansion to the translated return expression.
definitions.text:
rule checkDictReturn()
    => BoolOp(
         "and",
         Name("seen_key"),
         BoolOp("or", Name("all_lower"), Name("all_upper")))

definitions.rationale: Defines the named checkDictBody AST term by composing the exact initialization statements, loop-body definition, and return definition.
definitions.text:
rule checkDictBody()
    => Assign(Name("all_lower"), Bool(true))
       Assign(Name("all_upper"), Bool(true))
       Assign(Name("seen_key"), Bool(false))
       Assign(Name("key"), NoneVal)
       Assign(Name("is_string"), Bool(false))
       For(
         Name("key"),
         Call(Attribute(Name("dict"), "keys"), .Exprs),
         checkDictLoopBody())
       Return(checkDictReturn())

proved_derived_lemmas.rationale: The exact non-reference isinstance #applyK transition, including an arbitrary continuation, is proved as CONNECTION-SPEC.isinstance against CONNECTION, which imports PROOF-THEORY but not VERIFICATION; prove.sh runs that #Top proof before the loop and target proof commands.
proved_derived_lemmas.text:
rule <k> #applyK(
              toCall(builtinV("isinstance")),
              (V:Val, typeV("str"), .Vals))
        => isStringKey(V) ... </k>
    requires notBool isRefV(V)
    [priority(40)]

source_rules.rationale: Adds a simplification equation for the existing applyMethod operation on a guarded symbolic Val. Stage 1 proves constructor-level islower behavior through #applyK, but does not first prove this exact guarded applyMethod rewrite; therefore it is an additional trusted mathematical fact.
source_rules.text:
rule applyMethod(V:Val, "islower", .Vals)
    => lowerKeyCodes(stringCodes(V))
    requires isStringKey(V) andBool notBool isRefV(V)
    [simplification]
